It’s not just about solving problems but seeing how ideas connect.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, yes—especially if a problem feels too abstract or requires multiple steps. My high neuroticism might make me second-guess my answers more than others, but I learn from mistakes by breaking down each part carefully. Anxiety here often fades with practice and curiosity.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not directly, but I’ve explored chatbots like Mathway for quick checks when stuck on algebra or formulas. It was helpful for verifying work, though I still prefer working out problems myself to build understanding. The system sometimes gave unclear answers—like my openness score suggests I seek diverse perspectives.
